title: Fake-DOM piece 1: move chat-append-options / chat-render-markdown-text / chat-tool-rows / observation-basis-check / observation-bulk-scan onto loadWorld
description:
Piece 1 of LIN-4271's approved plan. **Needs no fake additions**, so it may run before or in parallel with piece 0.

### Slice of the approved plan

| path | tests | notes |
| -- | -- | -- |
| `tests/unit/chat-append-options.test.js` | 18 | client `public/chat.js:534-597`. Press via `listenersOf('click')` |
| `tests/unit/chat-render-markdown-text.test.js` | 7 | `chat.js:637-644`. `DOMPurify`/`marked` go in through `globals` |
| `tests/unit/chat-tool-rows.test.js` | 12 | `scrollTop`/`scrollHeight` are plain expandos (`chat.js:26-31`), and the test sets `thread.scrollHeight = 500` itself. Also `dataset` incl. `delete`, `hidden`, `insertBefore` |
| `tests/unit/observation-basis-check.test.js` | 9 | only `note.hidden` (`observation.js:2200`) |
| `tests/unit/observation-bulk-scan.test.js` | 18 | no test reaches the DOM. The `createElement` stub is never called |

Fake-internals replacements, each proven red under its mutation in the PR:

* `chat-render-markdown-text`: `el.innerHTML === null` ("never assigned") becomes `innerHTML === ''`, no children, original `textContent` kept. Mutation: assign `renderMarkdown`'s output on a no-op path (`chat.js:643`).
* `chat-tool-rows`: `deepEqual(groupRows(g), [a.li, b.li])` becomes a per-node `strictEqual` (the real `children` returns a fresh array). Mutation: skip grouping in `appendToolRow`.

Note: the chat suites were read and run unmodified at planning time, not ported. `basis-check`/`bulk-scan` ports are agent-reported only, so this PR re-proves every row.

**Rules for every move PR (from the plan):**

* Test names and counts stay the same. Before you touch a file: `node --test --test-reporter=spec <file> | sed -E 's/ \([0-9.]+ms\)$//' > before.txt`. After: the same into `after.txt`. Paste the empty `diff before.txt after.txt` and the pass counts into the PR. The counts must equal the plan's table.
* Remove each moved file from `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` (`tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js:51`) **and** add it to the consumer paragraph in the `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js` header, in the same PR (LIN-4265 comment `b6dfed3e`).
* Delete both copies in each suite: its own `FakeElement`/`FakeClassList` (or object-literal stubs) and its own `makeSandbox`/`load`/`vm.createContext`. Use `createFakeDom`/`loadWorld` (`tests/unit/helpers/client-world.js`).
* Never loosen an assertion that reads fake internals. Map it to a real-DOM replacement and prove the replacement goes red under the mutation it guards (the plan's "Fake-internals assertions" section). A replacement that cannot go red is a loosening and does not count.
* Every red that a real tree raises is a finding. The PR records each one as fixed, filed or fake artefact. Fix serializer differences (`disabled=""`, `hidden=""`, `checked=""`, escaping, parse errors on malformed markup or `<!doctype>`) in the test's regexes or fixtures, never by relaxing the fake.
* Never shim a missing shared-fake method in one file (no `doc.getElementById = …`). If you find a gap piece 0 missed, add it to `fake-dom.js` with its own `fake-dom.test.js` case, and say so on LIN-4271.
* LIN-4267/4268/4269 and the other pieces edit the same census list and header consumer paragraph. Before merge, update the branch against main and re-run CI on that head. `node --test tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` must be green on the merged head.
* Out of scope: the 7 `container.querySelector ? … : null` guards in `public/prompt-section.js` (LIN-4272 files the follow-up), `select` support in the fake, and adding `style`/`getBoundingClientRect`/scroll/real event dispatch.

### Acceptance

* The five files run on `createFakeDom`/`loadWorld` with an empty name diff and 18/7/12/9/18 passing.
* Their own fake classes and sandboxes are deleted.
* They are off `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` (55 → 50, or less any siblings that have landed) and in the `fake-dom.js` consumer paragraph.
* Both mutations are recorded red.

---

**Where the scope and design live.** Parent: **LIN-4271**. Read its description's `## Implementation Plan` (the approved plan, read at `473cc865`) and its `### Plan Review Verdict` comment `db80ceb2-14df-46c1-a163-29f74263f75e`, which has notes for the builder. Above that sit grandparent LIN-4255 and its course-change note `b4a44c2e-1ce0-4108-a524-eb94c3abfaee`. **The parent's approved plan is where this piece starts.** Follow it. Where the code shows the plan is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4271 (and on LIN-4255 if it changes the course-change note).

* Session fit: fits one session
* Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4271's approving plan-review (comment db80ceb2-14df-46c1-a163-29f74263f75e, rev 1)
* Grounding commit: `473cc865` (LinearViewer origin/main; the plan's read commit, still HEAD at breakdown on 2026-11-05, with no commits since to `tests/unit/helpers/`, the census, the fixture or the client files). Earlier beats read at `6d287518`.

### Outcome (close-out)

Implemented as the approved plan (LIN-4271, comment db80ceb2): the five suites now run on `createFakeDom`/`loadWorld`, their own fakes and sandboxes are deleted, and they are off `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and in the `fake-dom.js` consumer paragraph. Counts 18/7/12/9/18 with empty name diffs; both planned mutations recorded red.

* PR: [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2304](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2304>), squash-merged as `82e75ee9` (CI green on head `84d7ab58`).
* Deviation from the plan: one shared-helper seam, `world.run(code)` in `tests/unit/helpers/client-world.js` (with `tests/unit/client-world.test.js`), replaces the last raw `vm.runInContext` in `observation-basis-check`. Accepted at review.
* No plan, research or design sections were embedded in this description (the plan lives in LIN-4271's description), so nothing was pruned; the problem statement, slice, rules and acceptance above are kept as written.
* Full history: the task snapshots (pre-close-out description captured and verified identical) and the comment trail, including the `## Close-out — LIN-4280` comment.

comments.body:
PR is up and green: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2304 (head 6d227ef1, merged with origin/main 8369461c).

Beats, all on feat/lin-4280-fake-dom-piece-1:
- Beat 1 (ground): branch cut from 473cc865, no drift, baselines captured (18/7/12/9/18, exit 0).
- Beat 2: chat-append-options (18) and chat-render-markdown-text (7) ported to loadWorld (ecdec1f4).
- Beat 3: chat-tool-rows (12) ported (9f96b8b5).
- Beat 4: observation-basis-check (9) and observation-bulk-scan (18) ported (5900479b).
- Beat 5: loadWorld gains run(code), a script-scope seam, with tests/unit/client-world.test.js (eb9be98e). basis-check sets currentView through it; the raw vm line is gone. Census: five entries removed, consumer paragraph updated (523c8fd2). Merged origin/main (6d227ef1), resolving the consumer paragraph conflict with #2302.

Evidence on the merged head:
- Five files: empty strict diffs against baseline (duration_ms line stripped on both sides), counts 18/7/12/9/18, 0 failures.
- Full unit suite (npm run test:unit): 23708 of 23708 pass, exit 0. Base 473cc865 was 23608 of 23608 in the same run.
- Census: 43/43. fake-dom + client-world: 54/54.
- CI (Tests, run 42051973817): Unit tests pass; E2E shards 1-4 pass; Secret scan (source) pass; CI success pass. 7 of 7 checks pass.

Mutation witnesses (all red on intended tests): chat M1-M5, tool rows MA-MD, observation B1-B7 and K1-K5, helper W1-W2 and the Rulings gate. Output is in the PR description.

One flake: in one full-suite run before the merge, task-mode-routes.test.js "the reach lands in a real store..." failed (15 ms wait before a real-store read). It passes alone on both trees and passed on the immediate rerun and the merged head. Not touched by this PR; recorded as timing, not fixed.

Not merged, not Done. Review is needed.

**Autopilot run summary (stepper, implementation kind) — LIN-4280**

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2304 (head `6d227ef1`, base `main`, open, mergeable). Not merged, not Done: review is next, then close-out.

Beats run in one warm session (dispatch ids): 1/5 ground + baseline (54bff4ec), 2/5 chat-append-options + chat-render-markdown-text (121aed28), 3/5 chat-tool-rows (398acaa9), 4/5 observation-basis-check + observation-bulk-scan (74448ebb), 5/5 census + proof + PR (6e99b08e).

Evidence checked by autopilot directly (not just the worker's report): `gh pr view 2304` shows 9 changed files (+269/-415) matching the five suites, `client-world.js` + its test, the census test and the `fake-dom.js` consumer paragraph; statusCheckRollup is 7/7 SUCCESS (Unit tests, E2E shards 1-4, Secret scan, CI success). Worker-reported and recorded in the PR: empty baseline diffs with counts 18/7/12/9/18, full unit suite 23,708/23,708, census 43/43, mutation witnesses red on the intended tests.

Challenge I issued: beat 4 left a raw `vm.runInContext` in observation-basis-check; beat 5 resolved it by adding `world.run(code)` to `tests/unit/helpers/client-world.js` with tests, flagged in the PR as a reviewer decision (alternative: keep one vm line).

For the reviewer: (1) the `world.run` seam is a shared-helper addition beyond the ticket's "no fake additions" wording; (2) the baseline comparison strips the run-total `duration_ms` line as well as per-test timings; (3) the chat-render-markdown-text no-op assertion is `innerHTML === 'streamed so far'` (real-DOM serialization), still red under the empty-text mutation; (4) commits carry a Haiku 5.5 co-author trailer rather than the Sonnet 5.5 line the dispatch named; (5) one pre-existing timing flake (`task-mode-routes.test.js`, 15 ms wait) seen once pre-merge, not touched here.

## Review — LIN-4280

Reviewed PR #2304 at head `6d227ef1` (base `main` @ `8369461c`; origin/main has not moved, so the head already includes main). The PR is **open and not merged**. The distilled brief calls it "merged", which is wrong.

CI: green. All 7 checks pass on `6d227ef1`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1-4, Secret scan (source), CI success.

**Scope against the plan.** The PR changes 9 files: the five suites, the census, the `fake-dom.js` consumer paragraph, `client-world.js` and the new `client-world.test.js`. That matches the slice, plus one addition, the `world.run(code)` seam. The ticket said "needs no fake additions". The seam is in `client-world.js`, not the fake. It has its own tests, it removes the last raw `vm.runInContext` from basis-check, and the PR already reported it on LIN-4271 (comment 15:15Z). I accept it as in scope. None of the five files contains `vm.`, `createContext` or `FakeElement` any more.

**Independent re-run (mine, not the worker's numbers):**
- Counts on the head: 18/7/12/9/18, 0 failures. Census 43/43. client-world 3/3. fake-dom 51/51.
- Name diff: spec output on base `8369461c` vs head, with per-test timings and `duration_ms` stripped. All five diffs are empty.
- Census: 5 entries removed (52 → 47). The consumer paragraph lists all five plus `client-world.test.js`.

**Mutation checks (each reverted; tree clean afterwards):**
- M1: on the empty-text path in `chat.js:638`, assign `renderMarkdown`'s output. Result: **red** ("no-op on empty rawText").
- M1b: on that same no-op path, assign `innerHTML = ''`. Result: **red**.
- M2: skip grouping (`chat.js:223` branch → `false`). Result: **red**, 4 tests.
- M2c: swap `prev`/`li` when a new group is created (`chat.js:234-235`). Result: **red**, 2 tests.
- M2b: put a **third** row first in an existing group (`chat.js:221`, `appendChild` → `insertBefore(firstChild)`). Result: **green**. The test checks only `groupRows(group).length === 3`. The base suite had the same gap, so this is not a regression. But the new file header says "a grouping that puts the right rows in the wrong order … goes red", and that is true only for the path that creates the group. See L1.
- M3: make `world.run` a no-op. Result: **red** in client-world (3 tests) and basis-check (5 tests), so the Rulings-tab gate really runs through the seam.

**Regression check.** Recent history of the touched files is the fake-DOM series (#2291, #2297, #2298, #2299, #2302). There are no reverts and no re-applied changes. `#2302`'s consumer-paragraph entries survive the merge.

**One of a class?** Two other suites still set `currentView` with a raw `vm.runInContext`: `observation-scan-due.test.js` (piece 4, LIN-4283, which can now use `world.run`) and `observation-waiting-host.test.js` (not on the census list, so not a fake-DOM consumer). Both are **outside** this piece. The first belongs to LIN-4283. The second is no fake-DOM defect, so nothing to file.

**Other notes, none blocking:**
- In bulk-scan, `setImmediate`, `DOMException` and `window.window = window` were dropped. `observation.js` uses none of them.
- The commits carry a Haiku 5.5 co-author trailer. A squash merge's message can fix that.
- The `task-mode-routes` timing flake that the worker reported is untouched by this PR.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **L1 (inside: the `chat-tool-rows` fake-internals replacement, i.e. the plan's per-node `strictEqual` rule).** No test pins where a third row lands in an existing group (M2b stays green). Settle it before the merge. In `tests/unit/chat-tool-rows.test.js`, test "two adjacent rows merge…", change `ChatUI.appendToolRow(thread, { label: 'c' });` to `const c = ChatUI.appendToolRow(thread, { label: 'c' });`, and replace `assert.equal(groupRows(group).length, 3);` with `assertSameNodes(groupRows(group), [a.li, b.li, c.li], 'the third row joins at the end');`. Then confirm it goes **red** under M2b (`public/chat.js:221` `appendChild(li)` → `insertBefore(li, prev.children[0].children[1].firstChild)`), revert the mutation, and confirm 12/12 and an empty name diff.
- **L2 (inside: the merge-gate rule "census green on the merged head").** This review proved it on `6d227ef1` against main `8369461c`. Settle it before the merge: if main moves (pieces 0/2-6 edit the same census list and paragraph), update the branch, re-run CI, and run `node --test tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` on that head.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. All acceptance criteria are met and independently re-proven: counts, empty name diffs, deleted fakes and sandboxes, census and consumer paragraph, and both planned mutations red. The only gap is one missing identity assertion for the third row (L1), plus the usual re-check if main moves (L2).

## Close-out — LIN-4280

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2304, squash-merged as `82e75ee9` (pinned with `--match-head-commit 84d7ab58`, the commit CI passed on). Review verdict: Approve, conditional on the ledger (L1, L2). Both are settled below.

**Changes I made after the approval** (one commit, `84d7ab58`, test-only):
- `tests/unit/chat-tool-rows.test.js`, test "two adjacent rows merge…": the third row is now captured (`const c = …`) and the length check is replaced by `assertSameNodes(groupRows(group), [a.li, b.li, c.li], 'the third row joins at the end')`. Answers review line L1.

**Ledger**
- **L1 (inside), settled by the fix and a run.** Mutation M2b on `public/chat.js:221`: `appendChild(li)` → `insertBefore(li, list.children[0])`. The new assertion goes **red** ("the third row joins at the end: node 0", 11 pass / 1 fail). The old length-only assertion stays green under the same mutation (12/12), so the gap was real. Reverted; 12/12 and an empty name diff (spec output with timings and `duration_ms` stripped, before vs after). One correction to the review's recipe: it names `prev.children[0].children[1].firstChild` as the reference node, but the fake DOM has no `firstChild`. That makes `insertBefore(li, undefined)` an append, so the mutation as written is a no-op and stays green. I used `children[0]`, which is the same mutation. I did not add `firstChild` to the fake: nothing else needs it and it is out of this piece's scope.
- **L2 (inside), settled.** `origin/main` was re-read before the merge and was still `8369461c`, so the head already contained main. `node --test tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` on the new head: 43/43. Re-run on landed `main` (`82e75ee9`): 43/43.
- **Outside items:** none in the review. The raw `vm.runInContext` `currentView` setup in `observation-scan-due.test.js` belongs to LIN-4283 (noted there, no new ticket); `observation-waiting-host.test.js` is not a fake-DOM consumer, so nothing was filed. No follow-up tickets filed; no existing-ticket search hit needed.

**CI:** applies (GitHub Actions). On head `84d7ab58`: 7 of 7 checks pass (Unit tests, E2E shards 1-4, Secret scan (source), CI success; run 42053993051). Read fresh immediately before the merge, with the head still `84d7ab58` and mergeable.

**Post-merge:** the PR changed only tests and test helpers (no runtime file, `public/chat.js` untouched), so there is no deploy. Verified on landed `main` `82e75ee9`: chat-append-options 18, chat-render-markdown-text 7, chat-tool-rows 12, observation-basis-check 9, observation-bulk-scan 18, client-world 3, census 43, all with 0 failures. The post-merge Tests run on `main` was still in progress when I closed; its result is not recorded here.

**Not touched:** the `task-mode-routes` 15 ms timing flake the worker saw once. It did not recur in either CI run. Commits on the branch carry a Haiku 5.5 co-author trailer; the squash message carries the Sonnet 5.5 line.

**Description:** pre-prune snapshot archived and verified identical to the description; no plan/research/design sections were embedded, so nothing was pruned and a short Outcome stub was appended.
